title: scrophularia canina subsp. pinnatifida
intro: Scrophularia canina subsp. pinnatifida, commonly known as Alpine Figwort, is a plant species that belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional herbal medicine, where it is used to treat conditions such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues due to its health benefits in reducing oxidative stress and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Figwort include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its ability to modulate the body's response to infection and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and have been studied for their potential to exhibit cytotoxic and neuroprotective activities.
